Backend pytest 13/13 green (watchlist, xirr, resale xirr_pct, car-vs-property, uc-projection, breakeven-rtm-uc, tenant invite+login+me+receipts+razorpay-verify-rejects-bad-sig, admin legacy-transfer + admin-only gate). critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3607 lines — strongly recommend splitting into routers (calc.py, tenant.py, admin.py, projects.py). Guideline is <700 lines.
/api/tenant/pay/verify correctly HMAC-checks razorpay_signature and returns 400 on mismatch — verified.
/api/admin/legacy-transfer sets role='legacy_archived' on source user. Ensure auth middleware allows 'legacy_archived' users to still login read-only — currently login succeeds (verified in test).
Watchlist: /projects/{id}/watch upsert is idempotent; DELETE returns ok even if nothing deleted — good.
Tenant invite re-invite with new password correctly updates password_hash (idempotent) — verified via two back-to-back invite calls.
XIRR Newton-Raphson converges in tests; has bisection fallback — good. Early-returns 0 when no sign change in cashflows.
test_credentials: admin@estima.com / Admin@123 (used for admin + legacy-transfer). Tenant users created on-the-fly with TenantPass@123. Heir users created on-the-fly with Heir@12345.

A watched project is also added/removed idempotently. No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 fully verified: XIRR endpoint returns correct ~9.85% for test cashflow, resale-estimate includes xirr_pct, car-vs-property/uc-projection/breakeven-rtm-uc all return expected shapes with narratives. Tenant portal flow: invite creates user with role='tenant' (re-invite updates pw idempotently), login returns role='tenant' at top-level of response (NOT nested under 'user'), /tenant/me returns {user, tenant}, /tenant/receipts returns list, /tenant/pay/create-order works (razor test mode configured), /tenant/pay/verify rejects bad signatures with 400. Admin legacy-transfer creates new user+migrates properties/tenants/receipts/shares, archives source as role='legacy_archived'. Frontend: login response fields are flat (id/email/role/is_pro/plan) — do NOT assume nested user. Dashboard lives at /app (not /app/dashboard). Admin legacy button is on Users tab with title containing 'legacy'. /tenant route redirects non-tenant users to /app.
